Sample, review and export clips in a local app

Source: R/app.R
run_app.Rd

Opens a 'shiny' app, in the browser, for stages 1 and 2 of the workflow. The tabs depend on the arguments:

Usage

run_app(
  manifest = NULL,
  clips_dir = NULL,
  verdicts_file = NULL,
  reviewer = NULL,
  max_freq = NULL,
  selection_dir = NULL,
  output_dir = NULL,
  recordings = NULL,
  classifier = NULL,
  launch.browser = interactive(),
  ...
)

Arguments

manifest

Clip manifest: a data frame or the path to clip_manifest.csv (from select_clips(), cut_clips() or assign_reviewers()). With output_dir, by default <output_dir>/clip_manifest.csv when it exists.

clips_dir

Folder of the cut clips, with one subfolder per species (<clips_dir>/<species_folder>/<clip_file>, as written by cut_clips()). With output_dir, <output_dir>/clips by default.

verdicts_file

CSV where the verdicts are written. By default, verdicts.csv in output_dir or next to manifest when it is a path.

reviewer

Name of the reviewer, written with each verdict. With a manifest from assign_reviewers(), only the clips assigned to this reviewer (as first or second reviewer) are shown.

max_freq

Optional upper limit of the spectrogram, in kHz (e.g. 8 for most anuran calls). The whole band by default.

selection_dir

Folder of the BirdNET selection tables (as in read_selection_tables()). Opens the Sampling and Export tabs.

output_dir

Folder of the validation round: the clips, the manifest, the verdicts and the export (<output_dir>/occupancy by default) are written there.

recordings

Optional table of all recordings (columns site and source_audio), or the path to its CSV: needed by "random_recordings" and, in the export, to keep the occasions without detections (see export_occupancy_data()).

classifier

Label of the classifier, recorded in extraction_info.csv and schema.json.

launch.browser

Open the app in the browser? Passed to shiny::runApp().

...

Further arguments to shiny::runApp(), e.g. port.

Value

Called for its side effect; returns when the app is closed.

Details

  • Sampling (with selection_dir and output_dir): a form for the sampling design of select_clips(). Draw shows the clips per site and species and their inclusion probabilities without touching the audio; Cut clips cuts them with cut_clips() and writes clip_manifest.csv, extraction_info.csv and clips/ to output_dir, as extract_validation_clips() does (without the zip packages). The new clips go straight to the Review tab.

  • Review: the clips of a manifest one at a time, with the spectrogram and a player for each clip, its site, night, hour, score and design, and buttons to mark it positive, negative or uncertain. Each verdict is written at once to verdicts_file, so an interrupted session loses nothing and can be resumed. The tab replaces moving the clips into Positive and Negative folders in the BirdNET GUI; app_verdicts() turns verdicts_file into the table that classify_review() returns.

  • Export (with selection_dir and output_dir): calls export_occupancy_data() with the detections of selection_dir, the verdicts of the Review tab (combined by consensus_verdicts() when a clip has several reviewers) and, optionally, recordings, and shows the summary of schema.json. The score calibration is not in the app yet; call export_occupancy_data() with fit for it.

The app runs on the reviewer's computer and reads the clips from disk; nothing is uploaded.

Keyboard

In the Review tab: p positive, n negative, u uncertain, right arrow or space next clip, left arrow previous clip.

Verdicts file

A CSV with one line per click: clip_file, species_folder, reviewer, verdict ("positive", "negative" or "uncertain") and time. Lines are only appended; when a clip is marked again, the last verdict of the reviewer counts. Several reviewers can share one file or keep one each.

See also

app_verdicts(), vignette("review-app").

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Review only
run_app("validation/clip_manifest.csv", "validation/clips",
        reviewer = "liliana")

# Sample, cut, review and export
run_app(selection_dir = "N:/Arara", output_dir = "validation",
        recordings = "recordings.csv", reviewer = "liliana",
        max_freq = 8)
} # }
